/(/phyogs steng / sgra chos can/ rtag ste/ gzhal bya yin pa'i phyir/ mthun phyogs nam mkha' dang mi mthun phyogs bum pa gnyis ka la khyab byas pa yin no/ /sgra chos can/ 'jig ste/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ mthun phyogs bum pa la yod nges/ mi mthun phyogs nam mkha' la med nges pa yin no/ /sgra chos can/ rtsol ba las byung ste/ 'jig pa'i phyir mthun phyogs bum pa la khyab byed/ mi mthun phyogs glog dang nam mkha' gnyis la cha gnyis pa rim pa bzhin yin no/) g.yas/ (/phyogs bar/ sgra chos can/ rtag ste/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ mthun phyogs nam mkha' la med pa/ mi mthun phyogs bum pa la yod pa nges pa yin no/ /sgra chos can/ rtag ste/ mnyan bya yin pa'i phyir/ mthun phyogs nam mkha' dang / mi mthun phyogs bum pa gnyis ka la med nges pa yin no/ /sgra chos can/ rtag ste/ rtsol byung yin pa'i phyir/ mthun phyogs nam mkha' la med nges/ mi mthun phyogs bum pa dang glog gnyis la cha gnyis pa rim bzhin/) dbus/ ('khor lo 'og sgra chos can/ rtsol byung ma yin te/ 'jig pa'i phyir/ mthun phyogs glog dang nam mkha' gnyis la cha gnyis rim bzhin/ mi mthun phyogs bum pa la yod pa nges pa/ sgra chos can/ 'jig ste/ rtsol byung yin pa'i phyir/ mthun phyogs bum pa dang glog gnyis la rim bzhin cha gnyis pa/ mi mthun phyogs nam mkha' la med pa'o/ /sgra chos can/ rtag ste/ reg bya can min pa'i phyir/ mthun phyogs nam mkha' dang rdul phran la rim bzhin cha gnyis pa/ mi mthun phyogs las dang bum pa la rim bzhin cha gnyis pa'o/) g.yon/ rang gis mthong ba'i tshul gsum brjod pa yis/ /bsgrub bya lkog gyur gzhan la ston pa la/ /brjod tshul rtogs phyir phyogs chos can gyis ni/ /gtan tshigs rab tu dbye ba nges pa dgos/ /zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ste snga ma bzhin du rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /gzhan don rjes dpag bshad zin to//

༈ //tshad mar gyur pa'i bstan pa yid bzhin nor/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin ngag gi byi dor gyis/ /log smra'i dri ma ma lus sbyong mdzad pa/ /rigs pa'i gtsug rgyan gnyis kyi gzhung lugs la/ /sde bdun gong 'og bsdebs nas 'chad pa dang / /rgya 'grel legs cha btus nas 'chad pa dang / /rang gi rnam rtog nyid kyis 'chad pa ste/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'chad tshul rnam gsum las/ /skye ba du mar rigs lam goms byas nas/ /skyon med brgyud pa'i man ngag dang ldan zhing / /'jam dbyangs thugs kyi mkhyen pa mnga' ba yi/ /sa skya pa ni 'chad tshul dang por bzhed/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung rab padmo'i tshal/ /me tog la dga'i bung ba ltar bsten pas/ /tshig don ji bzhin blo yis legs rtogs nas/ /ston pa deng sang 'di na kho bo tsam/ /bstan las phyir gyur rtogs ge sde lnga dang / /tshu rol rtag rdzas smra ba'i thos sgrogs dang / /spyi dngos smra sogs gangs ri'i khrod gnas kyi/ /rtog ge ngan 'joms bstan bcos 'di byas so/ /srol 'byed 'gran zla med pa'i lha lam du/ /blo gros mtshungs pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /grub mtha' bla na med pa'i rta ljang gis/ /drangs phyir 'di la nyes pa med snyam sems/ /de lta na yang tshu rol mthong ba yis/ /gnas lugs lkog gyur 'chad pa dka' 'o zhes/ /rigs pa'i rgyal pos gsungs phyir nyes srid na/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod/ /thar pa don gnyer blo gros ldan rnams kyis/ /lto gos gtam snyan 'ba' zhig bsgrub slad du/ /gzhung lugs spangs nas tshig gis bslu byed pa'i/ /bshes gnyen ngan pa'i sgros la bag yod mdzod/ /ci slad ce na 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /brgal bar 'dod pa'i gru gzings bstan pa yin/ /de yang log par spyad na chu dbus su/ /'jig pas pha mthar phyin pa dka' phyir ro/ /de slad rang gzhan dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen yid bzhin nor bu len 'dod na/

/rigs lam gzer gyis bcos legs byas pa yi/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gru la 'jug par rigs/ /sde bdun rab gsal legs bshad bsnyad pa las/ /byung ba'i rnam dkar dge bas nyer mtshon nas/ /gzhan yang bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po gcig bsdus nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /gdul bya'i don du skye bo'i skur ston pa/ /kun dga' bzang po la sogs 'dren pa mchog /bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi/ /de ltar phul ba'i dge tshogs ci mchis dang / /brtse ldan bla ma'i thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i snying mun kun bsal nas/ /yang dag don gyis snang ba rgyas par shog /tshad ma'i dka' ba'i gnas rnam par bshad pa nyi ma/ me long / rnga sgra ste ming gi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa 'di ni/ dam chos smra ba'i dbang po byams chen rab 'byams pa'i gsung las/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la legs par sbyangs shing / khyad par du mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta la gsol la btab cing / de'i gsung rab gser gyi cod paṇa ltar blo gros kyi spyi bor bsten pas yang dag rigs pa'i snang ba phyogs med du rgyas pa shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seṅges lcags mo yos kyi lo cho 'phrul chen po'i skar ma rgyal gyi nyi ma la dga' ba tshal gyi dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhon nu rigs pa bzang po'o// ༈ //'di bsgrub pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba gang dang gang thob pa/ /des ni skye bo thams cad kyis/ /bde gshegs shes rab myur thob shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa brnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
